title: Copilot Studio: self-learning recommendations to refine agents
summary: The briefing accurately separates Microsoft's planned self-learning behaviour from documented Copilot Studio licensing and cost controls. Its roadmap dates match the record, and independent searches confirmed the stated gaps in feature-specific documentation.

claims.claim: Copilot Credits measure agent usage in Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are the unit that measures agent usage.

claims.claim: Agent flows are predefined flow-action sequences that perform repetitive tasks without agent reasoning and orchestration at each step.
claims.quote: agent flows, which are predefined sequences of flow actions to execute repetitive tasks quickly, without requiring agent reasoning and orchestration at each step.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not identify which type of workflow self-learning will propose.
claims.quote: It will identify repeated tool sequences that can be handled by workflows

claims.claim: Billable standard-harness reasoning-model usage adds 10 Copilot Credits per 1,000 billed tokens to applicable feature rates.
claims.quote: Total cost = feature rate for the operation + text and generative AI tools (premium) for the reasoning model's token usage. ... Copilot Credits are calculated from the exact number of billed tokens, at 10 Copilot Credits per 1,000 tokens.

claims.claim: Tokens read from the prompt cache are excluded from that reasoning-model token charge.
claims.quote: the text and generative AI tools (premium) charge is based on the tokens that the model processes, except the tokens that it reads from its prompt cache

claims.claim: Eligible employee-facing standard-harness usage with an authenticated Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed identity is included, subject to fair usage and exclusions.
claims.quote: included in the Microsoft Copilot USL when the user of the agent is licensed with Microsoft Copilot, and the agent operates using the authenticated Microsoft Copilot USL user's identity. ... Usage is limited to fair usage limits.

claims.where: controls[0]; summary; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No tenant, environment or agent-level UI or API switch for self-learning recommendations is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "self-learning" "settings" "default"; "Copilot Studio" "self-learning" "API" "table". Read What's new, settings excerpts, Dataverse bot reference and pac admin; no self-learning switch found.

claims.claim: An agent's monthly credit limit is set at Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit.
claims.quote: In the Power Platform admin center, go to Licensing > Copilot Studio. ... Select Manage Agents. ... Select the agent, and then select Set limit.

claims.claim: No API for setting an individual agent's monthly credit limit is documented in the references searched.
claims.quote: Searched monthly agent credit limit with Power Platform API, Dataverse bot, pac admin and PowerShell. Read capacity, harness cost, Dataverse bot and pac admin references; searched bot and CLI text for credit/monthly/consumption/limit; no setting operation found.

claims.claim: Stopping an agent at its monthly limit is optional through Stop usage.
claims.quote: Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: Monthly agent limits are not applied instantly.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Cost and licensing; Governance controls
claims.claim: An agent's monthly limit does not stop agent flows it calls.
claims.quote: An agent's monthly limit doesn't stop the agent flows that the agent calls.

claims.claim: The monthly limit is a general per-agent Copilot Studio consumption control rather than a self-learning switch.
claims.quote: Admins can set monthly consumption limits for each Copilot Studio agent, regardless of whether the environment uses prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go billing.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents provides agent-level billed-credit consumption for identifying high-use agents.
claims.quote: In the Power Platform admin center, go to Licensing > Copilot Studio. ... Select Manage Agents. ... Agent: Review month-to-date billed credits, configured limits, and agent status.

claims.claim: Administrators can configure a notification threshold with an agent's monthly Copilot Credit limit.
claims.quote: Enter the monthly Copilot Credit limit. ... Configure the notification threshold.
